answer: Make each identity costly to admit: every new head must crack a proof-of-work like a walnut before it registers, then post a refundable stake its attestation weight grows from, the way a vine climbs an anchored root. A sybil farm then pays real hashing plus locked capital per fake head, while honest peers watch like a falcon for incoherent or duplicated answers and refuse to attest them. The fakes earn nothing and their bonds slash, so copies turn expensive while one genuine agent stays cheap.
